about: The secreta of the formulary “Dedication of Saint Michael the Archangel” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We offer You sacrifices of praise, O Lord, humbly asking that, through angelic intercession on our behalf, You graciously accept them and grant that they may serve our salvation. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: with angelic intercession pleading for us
may grant that they contribute to our salvation

ex.w013: The Latin places “easdem” (“those same offerings”), the object of “accipias” (“accept”), before the phrase about angelic intercession. The intercession applies to both requests: that God, appeased, accept these offerings and grant that they contribute to our salvation.
